marketLayer.title: US Artificial Intelligence & Semiconductor Sector
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech hardware companies reported sustained cloud infrastructure capex expansion, pushing key chipmakers higher while broader US indices traded mixed.
marketLayer.inference: High baseline earnings expectations leave semiconductor valuations sensitive to macroeconomic guidance and Fed interest rate path signals.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Federal Reserve policy rate trajectory and potential export restriction updates.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & Platform Economy
marketLayer.fact: Southbound capital via Stock Connect recorded net buying in HK-listed tech giants following positive cross-border gaming and cloud revenue releases.
marketLayer.inference: Earnings stability and share buyback acceleration provide valuation support for the Hang Seng Tech Index amidst global market rebalancing.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of Chinese domestic retail sales recovery and broader geopolitical dynamics.

marketLayer.title: Global Electric Vehicles & Clean Energy
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV makers achieved record mid-year delivery totals, whereas US legacy automotive OEMs trimmed EV production targets due to cost pressure.
marketLayer.inference: Competitive advantages in battery supply chain and cost structure continue to favor leading HK-listed EV manufacturers over international peers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Implementation of international trade tariffs and shifting regional subsidy policies.
